headline: Oil Slides Following Iran Supreme Leader's Hint at US Dialogue
summary: Oil prices declined after Iran's Supreme Leader suggested pursuing dialogue with the United States.
why: Geopolitical developments involving major oil-producing nations like Iran can directly influence crude supply expectations and global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Potential easing of US-Iran tensions can reduce perceived supply disruption risks, pushing oil prices down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hints of diplomatic dialogue between Iran and the US reduce geopolitical risk premiums embedded in crude prices.
